d: Long, flowing platinum white hair with choppy bangs and a slight pinkish tint at the tips frames a youthful, mature face. Sharp, narrow crimson eyes with a focused expression are accented by a single red vertical line beneath the left eye. The slender build is dressed in a white high-collared garment layered over a black undershirt, complemented by black and red armored shoulder plating and a red decorative knot at the chest.
